zh-HK: 新增完整使用教學（user-guide.html）：15 章圖文教學，中英文、可搜尋，由首頁「📖 完整使用教學」打開
首頁「快速開始」改為 5 步卡片，按現時功能重寫，可摺疊並記住
表單類型全面更新：客戶資料頂部 6 個類型晶片；PDF／HTML 按類型顯示價錢、有效期、付款條款及簽署格（樣品單顯示 FOC、送貨單唔印價錢）
Lyreco 公司資料及客戶資料面板改版：並排顯示、標題即時摘要、分段子摺疊、縮寫｜全名細掣
送貨條款重做：11 個常用條款晶片及收貨時間／午膳／可收貨日子／位置／聯絡人／樓梯搬運；PDF、Email、WhatsApp 以獨立「Delivery Terms」顯示
備註及預設條款改版：套用建議條款可復原、清除內容、條款即時預覽及插入變數、Ctrl／⌘+S 儲存
品牌與付款資訊改版：QR 類型卡及 PDF 預覽、WhatsApp 自動生成、下載 QR；修正 Logo／浮水印上傳掣冇反應
匯出郵件選單升級：搜尋範本、⭐ 常用、最近使用、鍵盤操作；報價 Email 加報價摘要並可下載 Outlook 草稿（.eml）
en: New full user guide (user-guide.html): 15 illustrated chapters in Chinese and English with search, opened from "📖 Full user guide" on the main page
Quick start on the main page is now a 5-step card rewritten for current features; collapsible and remembered
Form types overhauled: 6 type chips in Customer Info; PDF / HTML show prices, validity, payment terms and signature box per type (Sample Order shows FOC, Delivery Note hides prices)
Lyreco Company Info and Customer Info panels redesigned: side by side, live header summary, grouped sub-sections, Abbreviate | Full name toggle
Delivery terms rebuilt: 11 quick chips plus receiving hours, lunch, receiving days, location, contact and stair carry; shown as a separate Delivery Terms block in PDF, email and WhatsApp
Remarks and default terms redesigned: undo for suggested terms, clear, live term preview with variables, Ctrl / ⌘+S to save
Brand & payment redesigned: QR type cards with PDF preview, WhatsApp auto-generate, QR download; fixed logo / watermark upload buttons doing nothing
Export Email menu upgraded: template search, pinned and recent templates, keyboard control; quotation email adds a summary and can be downloaded as an Outlook draft (.eml)
